stories.title: Create BEV C03-C04 Knowledge Assessment (KA) with Varied Question Types and Answer Schemes
stories.description: Develop comprehensive Knowledge Assessment documents for BEV Competency Units C03 (Thermal Cooling Systems) and C04 (Electric Drive Train) following JPK Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020. Each KA must include 25-30 questions with varied formats (MCQ 40%, structured answer 35%, practical scenario 25%), integrated answer schemes, and bilingual terminology.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md created for C03 with 25-30 questions covering thermal cooling systems, categorized by question type with clear answer schemes and marking rubrics
KA.md created for C04 with 25-30 questions covering electric drive train, categorized by question type with clear answer schemes and marking rubrics
All questions map to specific Related Knowledge items from bev-diagnostic-rectification/00-noss-extract.md; bilingual (EN/BM) terminology consistent with existing KP documents
technicalNotes: File to reference: bev-diagnostic-rectification/00-noss-extract.md (extract Related Knowledge items for C03/C04 scope)
Test command: grep -E '^### Question|^Answer:|^Rubric:' bev-diagnostic-rectification/C03/KA.md | wc -l (verify document structure has minimum expected questions and rubrics)

stories.title: Develop Aesthetic C02 Assignment Sheets (KT-01 to KT-03) with Integrated Grading Rubrics
stories.description: Create three Assignment Sheets (KT documents) for Aesthetic Services C02 (body consultation and thermal therapy), aligned to KP content. Each sheet includes practical tasks, submission requirements, 4-level grading rubrics (Excellent/Good/Satisfactory/Unsatisfactory), and cross-references to related theory. All instructions bilingual (EN + BM).
acceptanceCriteria: Create KT-01.md (body consultation assessment), KT-02.md (thermal therapy technique application), KT-03.md (treatment planning case study) under aesthetic-services/C02/
Each KT includes: task objectives, detailed bilingual instructions, assessment criteria, and 4-point grading rubric with observable evidence descriptors
All three KT documents include metadata cross-references linking to specific KP-01 and KP-02 theory sections (e.g., 'Based on KP-01: Body Analysis Techniques')
technicalNotes: File to reference: aesthetic-services/C02/KP-01.md, aesthetic-services/C02/KP-02.md (for creating cross-reference mappings)
Test command: grep -c '\[KP Reference:' aesthetic-services/C02/KT-*.md (verify each file has valid KP cross-reference; expect count ≥ 3)

stories.title: Audit IT-020 Bilingual Terminology Across All CU Documents and Create Master Glossary with Consistency Report
stories.description: Conduct systematic audit of all IT-020 Computer System Management CU documents (C03, C04, C05) to extract technical terminology, map to standard Malay (BM) equivalents using Malaysian IT industry standards, and identify consistency issues. Deliver master glossary (minimum 80 terms) and validation report highlighting multiple translations and missing equivalents.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract all unique English technical terms from it-computer-system/C03/KP-*.md, C04/KP-*.md, C05/KP-*.md; create IT-020-bilingual-glossary.md with columns: English Term, Malay Equivalent, Definition, Usage Example, CU Reference (minimum 80 terms)

Generate terminology-validation-report.md listing: (a) English terms with multiple conflicting BM translations (flag inconsistencies), (b) English terms missing BM equivalents, (c) BM terms not aligned with standard Malaysian IT terminology
Glossary format validated: each entry properly formatted as markdown table row with all 5 columns populated; all BM equivalents verified against MySPIKE or official Malaysian IT industry glossaries
technicalNotes: Extraction command: grep -oE '\b[A-Z][a-z]+(\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*\b' it-computer-system/C{3,5}/KP-*.md | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn (identify candidate technical terms)
Test command: grep -E '^\|.*\|.*\|.*\|.*\|' it-computer-system/_docs/IT-020-bilingual-glossary.md | wc -l (verify minimum 80 complete glossary entries with all 5 columns)
